podcast.body: Released in 2002, this remix album featured reinterpretations of songs from *Hybrid Theory*. It served to capitalize on the success of the debut and provided the band with crucial time before recording their second studio album, *Meteora*. "Lincoln Park, Hossalotto Remix, album entitled Reanimation."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Released in 2002, this was a 20-track remix album co-produced by Mike Shinoda. Creating a remix album so early in their career was unusual, but Warner Brothers Records approved it due to the strong sales of their debut, Hybrid Theory. The album went on to sell two million copies and is recognized as the third best-selling remix album of all time. "Reanimation is officially the third best-selling remix album of all time."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This remix album was released between the band's first and second studio albums, Hybrid Theory and Meteora, contributing to their high productivity during that period. "And let's not forget that reanimation remix album that was dropped in there too."
